_comment: The first honest recall denominator for Actenon Scan. Verified labels are backed by corpus-triage.json file:line entries; estimated labels are explicitly marked verified=false and DO NOT count toward the recall formula. See tests/benchmark/recall_methodology.md and docs/RECALL.md.

summary.verified_recall_note: TRIVIAL AND UNINFORMATIVE. Of the 21 verified labels with agent_reachable=true and guarded=false, all 21 were caught by scan. But the sample is biased: every verified label comes from a finding scan already surfaced (per corpus-triage.json). We have hand-labeled ZERO files that scan reported as clean. The verified recall is therefore a tautology, not a measurement. It is published only because the schema requires a number.
summary.confidence_interval_95_verified_note: Wilson score interval at 95% for 21/21 = [0.845, 1.0]. Meaningless for the same reason the verified recall is meaningless: the sample is biased. The lower bound (0.845) does not bound the true recall — the true recall is unknown because we have not measured any false negatives.
summary.estimated_recall_range_note: ESTIMATE — NOT A MEASUREMENT. Across the 25 pinned repos, we estimate scan misses between 5 and 50 agent-reachable unguarded consequential actions, with a point estimate of 20. This corresponds to an estimated recall range of 29.6% to 80.8% (point estimate 51.2%): 21/71=29.6% at the worst-case upper bound on misses, 21/41=51.2% at the point estimate, 21/26=80.8% at the best-case lower bound on misses. The estimate is derived from coverage gaps in docs/COVERAGE.md: r05 (custom agent loop) NOT COVERED, r06 (action/observation) NOT COVERED historical, r04 (@function_tool) PARTIAL, r07 (raw tool-schema dispatch) PARTIAL. The lower bound assumes the worst-case count of misses in each NOT COVERED/PARTIAL architecture; the upper bound assumes the best case (lower bound of estimated misses per architecture). This range is NOT a confidence interval and does NOT have statistical coverage. It is the result of reasoning about coverage gaps, not sampling. The only way to convert this estimate into a measurement is to follow recall_methodology.md §8: clone the pinned repos at their SHAs, hand-label 20 files per repo across 3 repos, and update this file with verified=true entries.
summary.honest_verdict: NOT YET COMPUTABLE. Methodology documented. Sample collection required.
what_would_be_needed: Clone the 25 pinned repos at their pinned SHAs (pinned_repos.json)
Hand-label 20 files per repo across 3 repos (60 files total), stratified per recall_methodology.md §3.2
For each file, follow the labeling protocol in recall_methodology.md §4
Append verified=true entries to this file with real repo/file/line/sink_call_text
Recompute the summary block; the Wilson 95% CI updates with the new n
